color.note: Each theme is a question skin. Components read only these semantic names, so swapping data-theme reskins every screen. Answer, status and BSOD colours are fixed across skins.

tokens.name: desktop
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind every window: the phone page background. Never put body text directly on it; put text in a `window`.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window body and card surface. Default ground for all text.

tokens.name: window-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `window` and `button`-less surfaces. Questions, answers, names.

tokens.name: window-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `window`: hints, status bar copy, timestamps.

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Start of the title-bar gradient (flat in Fakebook).

tokens.name: titlebar-end
tokens.usage: End of the title-bar gradient. Title text must read on both ends.

tokens.name: titlebar-ink
tokens.usage: Window titles and title-bar controls on `titlebar` → `titlebar-end`.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Outer window border and the 3px chunky frame around windows.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Default button face, wager chips at rest, tray/taskbar pills.

tokens.name: button-ink
tokens.usage: Label text on `button`.

tokens.name: button-border
tokens.usage: 1px button and input outline; meets 3:1 on `window` (or the face itself does).

tokens.name: bevel-light
tokens.usage: Top-left inner bevel highlight on buttons and inputs (the 2000s 3D look).

tokens.name: bevel-dark
tokens.usage: Bottom-right inner bevel shadow; also the pressed state's top-left edge.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen: Lock In, Join, Start. The skin's signature colour (the green pill in FlopXP).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `accent`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Selected row/chip/answer outline, list selection, progress fill.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight`.

tokens.name: sparkle
tokens.usage: Decoration only: glitter, stars, marquee, confetti. Never text, never a state.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, offset 2px so it lands on `window`/`desktop`; ≥3:1 on both in every skin.

tokens.name: answer-a
tokens.usage: Answer A (▲). Same in every skin so phones never change meaning between questions. White `on-answer` text.

tokens.name: answer-b
tokens.usage: Answer B (◆). Paired with its shape; never rely on colour alone.

tokens.name: answer-c
tokens.usage: Answer C (●). Darkened amber so `on-answer` holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: answer-d
tokens.usage: Answer D (■). Told apart from A by shape + letter, not hue.

tokens.name: on-answer
tokens.usage: Letter, shape and answer text on `answer-a` … `answer-d`.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Correct reveal fill (light lime). Always with ✓ and the word CORRECT. Lightness differs from `wrong` by 5.7:1.

tokens.name: on-correct
tokens.usage: Text on `correct`.

tokens.name: wrong
tokens.usage: Wrong reveal fill (deep red). Always with ✗ and a troll word (WRONG, LOL, NOPE).

tokens.name: on-wrong
tokens.usage: Text on `wrong`.

tokens.name: favourite
tokens.usage: Host's Fave: the answer the birthday host crowned on opinion questions. Star glyph required.

tokens.name: on-favourite
tokens.usage: Text on `favourite`.

tokens.name: bsod
tokens.usage: Blue Screen of Birthday: final question and the crash transition. Fixed in every skin.

tokens.name: bsod-ink
tokens.usage: All text on `bsod`.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR modules only. Pure black for scanner reliability in every skin.

tokens.name: qr-paper
tokens.usage: QR quiet zone and background only. Pure white.

tokens.name: lcd
tokens.usage: Brick Phone LCD screen (fixed in every theme, like `bsod`).

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: All text and pixels on `lcd`; also captions on `brick-body`.

tokens.name: lcd-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `lcd`: sender, time, soft-key labels.

tokens.name: brick-body
tokens.usage: Brick Phone plastic casing behind the LCD and keypad.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Brick Phone keypad keys.

tokens.name: key-ink
tokens.usage: Digits and letters on `key`.

tokens.name: huat-red
tokens.usage: Chaos: Huat Ah! banner and red packets. Fixed in every skin.

tokens.name: huat-gold
tokens.usage: Chaos: gold ingots, 发 glyph, banner trim. Text on it is `huat-red` at 24px+ bold only (4.1:1).

tokens.name: on-huat
tokens.usage: Text on `huat-red`.

tokens.name: slip-paper
tokens.usage: Chaos: the TOTE-LLY LUCKY lottery slip paper.

tokens.name: slip-ink
tokens.usage: Chaos: slip grid, numbers and pen circles on `slip-paper`.

tokens.name: forward-bubble
tokens.usage: Chaos: Auntie's forwarded good-morning message bubble.

tokens.name: forward-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `forward-bubble`.

tokens.name: tissue
tokens.usage: Chaos: the tissue packet that chopes an answer tile.

tokens.name: tissue-ink
tokens.usage: Text printed on `tissue`; also the pencil strokes marking lottery numbers.

tokens.name: slip-red
tokens.usage: Chaos: TOTE-LLY slip number boxes, labels and VOID bars. As text on `slip-paper` too.

tokens.name: on-slip-red
tokens.usage: White labels on `slip-red` fills.

tokens.name: slip-gold
tokens.usage: Chaos: TOTE-LLY slip side panel.

tokens.name: on-slip-gold
tokens.usage: Wordmark on `slip-gold`, 20px+ bold only.

tokens.name: receipt-paper
tokens.usage: Chaos: the 4D thermal receipt.

tokens.name: receipt-ink
tokens.usage: All text and barcode bars on `receipt-paper`.

tokens.name: receipt-watermark
tokens.usage: Faint repeating 67 watermark behind the receipt text.

tokens.name: sale
tokens.usage: Chaos: 12.3 birthday-sale pop-up background.

tokens.name: sale-deep
tokens.usage: Darker end of the sale gradient and voucher edges.

tokens.name: on-sale
tokens.usage: Text on `sale` / `sale-deep`.

tokens.name: sale-yellow
tokens.usage: Sale highlights: 12.3, countdown digits, vouchers.

tokens.name: on-sale-yellow
tokens.usage: Text on `sale-yellow`.

tokens.name: answers
tokens.usage: Chaos: Yah! Answers header.

tokens.name: on-answers
tokens.usage: Text on `answers`.

styles.name: phone-question
styles.sample: What was Anne's first MSN display name?
styles.usage: Question text on players' phones. Keep questions under ~110 characters so they fit above four answers.

styles.name: phone-answer
styles.usage: Answer tile text (max ~40 characters, two lines).

styles.name: phone-display
styles.usage: Points won/lost, wager value, big counters. Press Start 2P: keep to ~8 characters.

styles.name: phone-timer
styles.usage: Countdown seconds in the question header.

styles.name: phone-body
styles.usage: Body copy and inputs. Never smaller than 16px on inputs (stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status bars, hints, metadata. Never for anything a player must act on.

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: Fake menu bars, tab strips and address-bar labels (flavour only).

styles.name: dollz-display
styles.usage: Dollz Dreamhouse headers and the Instagran wordmark. Script only for headers, never answers.

styles.name: comic-body
styles.usage: Chat bubbles in Fakebook chat, MySpaze and Instagran comments.

styles.name: lcd-display
styles.usage: Blue Screen of Birthday text and the Brick Phone LCD.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Bevel insets, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Title-bar control gaps, chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical), list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window body padding and phone screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutters between answer tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Phone screen side padding on roomy screens, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between phones in previews; large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Minimum tap-target height on phones.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: MySpaze tables, Blue Screen of Birthday, Fakebook panels.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: FlopXP and Fakebook buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Top corners of FlopXP windows (bottom stays square).

tokens.name: radius-bubbly
tokens.usage: Igloo, Monster, Dollz and Build-a-Blunder windows and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Start pill, wager chips, reaction bubbles.

shadow.note: Per skin: glossy drop shadows for the Windows family, hard offsets for the cartoon skins, none for MySpaze.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Every window.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel
tokens.usage: Raised buttons and chips at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected buttons, locked wager chip.
